assets.name: Music_Combat
assets.note: Combat bed: 128 BPM, 32 bars = exactly 60 s, A minor (Am F C G, two bars each). Four 8-bar sections build: drums + bass + arp, then snare + pad, then the lead, then everything; a snare fill and riser lead back to the top. Seamless loop.

assets.name: Music_Intro
assets.note: Intro bed, played once: an A drone opening over 34 s, a slow pulse from 10 s, a rising arpeggio from 20 s, a swell into one hit at 34 s (the hand-over to wave 1) and a ringing A minor ninth chord. 40 s.

assets.name: Weapon_NeedleCannons
assets.note: Lancer primary, the anchor: a tight, dry needle. Fires most often, so it is short and has no tail.

assets.name: Weapon_PhasePulseLasers
assets.note: Rift primary: bright and phasey. Detuned saws with FM, a shimmer on top.

assets.name: Weapon_SplitterBolt
assets.note: Rift secondary: three rising chirps (the bolt that splits) over one body.

assets.name: Weapon_SpikeRockets
assets.note: Lancer secondary: a launch thunk and a rocket hiss leaving.

assets.name: Weapon_BreakerBlaster
assets.note: Bastion primary: a heavy thump. Low sine drop, a dark saw body, a short crack.

assets.name: Weapon_FlakBurst
assets.note: Bastion secondary: a dull mortar poomp.

assets.name: Weapon_MissileSwarm
assets.note: Bastion swarm: one small missile leaving the rack; many of these overlap.

assets.name: Enemy_PulseGuns
assets.note: Null Armada fighter guns: darker and growlier than any squad weapon (sub-octave FM).

assets.name: Enemy_Missile
assets.note: Interceptor / gunship missile launch.

assets.name: Impact_Hull
assets.note: A shot on armour: a thud plus three inharmonic metal partials that change per take.

assets.name: Impact_Hull_Taken
assets.note: Same takes, louder: enemy fire landing on the squad must be noticed.

assets.name: Impact_Hull_Far
assets.note: Same takes with the far attenuation: hits on the Dominion's generators and reactor.

assets.name: Impact_Shield
assets.note: A shot on an energy shield: glassy, rising, no thud.

assets.name: Impact_Shield_Taken
assets.note: A shot on an energy shield: glassy, rising, no thud.

assets.name: Impact_Shield_Far
assets.note: A shot on an energy shield: glassy, rising, no thud.

assets.name: Impact_World
assets.note: A shot on rock or structure: a dull crack.

assets.name: Detonation_Rocket
assets.note: Rocket, missile and mine warheads: a sharp small blast.

assets.name: Detonation_Flak
assets.note: Flak: a crackling burst rather than one boom.

assets.name: Deflected
assets.note: A shot turned aside: a rising metallic ping.

assets.name: Explosion_Small
assets.note: Fighter / interceptor / turret: crack, falling body, sub drop, crackling debris.

assets.name: Explosion_Medium
assets.note: Gunship / bomber / a squad ship lost.

assets.name: Explosion_Large
assets.note: Carrier, shield generator, reactor: two booms and a long low tail.

assets.name: Dominion_Breakup
assets.note: The mothership coming apart: six staggered booms, a metal groan, a long rumble. The loudest thing in the game.

assets.name: Engine_Lancer
assets.note: Interceptor: a tight mid whine over a fast flutter. Gameplay pitches it 0.8x to 1.4x by speed.

assets.name: Engine_Rift
assets.note: Trickster: hollow odd harmonics, wide detune and a slow phasing hiss.

assets.name: Engine_Bastion
assets.note: Heavy: a low throb with a rumble bed.

assets.name: Boost_Start
assets.note: Afterburner kick: a thump and a rising rush.

assets.name: Drift_Loop
assets.note: Drift: a strained, fluttering energy screech (kept under 6.5 kHz so it does not tire).

assets.name: Dodge
assets.note: Side-thruster burst.

assets.name: Alarm_LowHull
assets.note: Low-hull warning: two soft notes every half second over a quiet bed. 2D, SFX class (stops when the game pauses). Wired once gameplay starts and stops LowHullLoop.

assets.name: Shield_Break
assets.note: A shield failing: a glassy FM fall and crackle.

assets.name: UI_HitConfirm
assets.note: A shot landed: one tiny tick. NOT played yet: nothing reads UTDUIStyle::HitConfirm.

assets.name: UI_KillConfirm
assets.note: A kill: two rising bell notes (E6, B6).

assets.name: Enemy_WarpIn
assets.note: An enemy arriving: a swelling growl that snaps into a thud.

assets.name: Enemy_Telegraph
assets.note: The wind-up before a big enemy attack: a rising, pulsing warning that has to cut through a dogfight.

assets.name: Enemy_DeathTumble
assets.note: A crippled ship spinning out: a falling, wobbling whine with sputter.

assets.name: Squad_RespawnWarpIn
assets.note: A squad ship returning: a rising rush that lands on a bright bell (friendly, unlike the enemy warp).

assets.name: Dominion_WarpIn
assets.note: The mothership arrives: a boom under a slow, detuned low horn (root and fifth).

assets.name: Dominion_ReactorExposed
assets.note: The reactor laid bare: power building to a hit.

assets.name: Power_Ram_Windup
assets.note: Lancer afterburner ram, charge: a fast rising whine.

assets.name: Power_Ram
assets.note: Lancer ram: a hard afterburner blast that tears past.

assets.name: Power_PortalShot
assets.note: Rift portal blaster firing: a deep, phasey vwoop.

assets.name: Portal_Open
assets.note: A portal tearing open: a swell that blooms into a bell.

assets.name: Portal_Idle
assets.note: An open portal or gate: a hollow, slowly phasing hum with a faint sparkle.

assets.name: Portal_Transit
assets.note: Something passing through a portal or gate (a ship, or a missile sent back): up then down, quick.

assets.name: Power_Swarm
assets.note: Bastion missile swarm: racks unlock (clunk, two ticks) and the salvo rush starts; each missile then has its own launch.

assets.name: Power_Dome_Up
assets.note: Bastion shield dome raising: a wide shimmer swell on a low anchor.

assets.name: Ability_Cloak_On
assets.note: Rift cloak: the ship shimmers away (falling, fluttering glass).

assets.name: Ability_EMP
assets.note: Lancer EMP pulse: a sub thump with a wide electric crackle.

assets.name: Ability_EMP_Zap
assets.note: One hostile caught by the EMP; several play together, so it is short and quiet.

assets.name: Ability_GravityWell_On
assets.note: Bastion gravity well: everything is pulled down and in, then a boom.

assets.name: Switch_Rift
assets.note: The switch cut to Rift. All three share one splice (whoosh + shutter click); the tone names the ship: Rift a bright rising FM blip.

assets.name: Switch_Lancer
assets.note: The switch cut to Lancer: two hard, quick ticks (A6, E7).

assets.name: Switch_Bastion
assets.note: The switch cut to Bastion: a low, falling thud tone (G3 to C3).

assets.name: Cine_Slate
assets.note: Take start: a clapperboard. A soft hinge flick, then a dry woody crack in a small room. NOT wired: no cue slot exists for the slate.

assets.name: Cine_Cut
assets.note: "CUT!" without a voice: the slate crack, a stage buzzer, and the scene winding down like stopped tape. NOT wired: no cue slot exists.

assets.name: Cine_SlowMoIn
assets.note: Into a slow-motion money shot: everything sinks. NOT wired: no cue slot exists.

assets.name: Hyperdrive_Spool
assets.note: Hyperdrive wind-up (the spool lasts 1.2 s): a detuned riser and a rising rush.

assets.name: Hyperdrive_Tunnel
assets.note: Inside the jump: a rushing bed with a slow swirl and a high shimmer. 2D.

assets.name: Hyperdrive_DropOut
assets.note: Dropping out of the jump: a boom and a fast deceleration.

assets.name: Hyperdrive_Refused
assets.note: Hyperdrive locked: a low double knock (consonant = good, low knock = no).

assets.name: Travel_AtmosphericEntry
assets.note: Atmospheric entry: buffeting wind roar. 2D.

assets.name: UI_Move
assets.note: Menu move: one soft tick (E6). NOT wired: menus have no sound slot.

assets.name: UI_Confirm
assets.note: Confirm: A5 up to E6.

assets.name: UI_Back
assets.note: Back: C6 down to G5.

assets.name: UI_PauseIn
assets.note: Pause: the world dips (A5 gliding down an octave).

assets.name: Objective_Complete
assets.note: Objective complete: A4 C5 E5 A5 bells rising. NOT wired: no cue slot exists.

assets.name: Blade_Ignite
assets.note: Energy blade on: a snap, a rising buzz that settles.

assets.name: Blade_SwingLight
assets.note: Light swing: the hum sweeping past.

assets.name: Blade_Hit
assets.note: Blade lands: a crackling zap and a thud.

assets.name: Blade_Deflect
assets.note: A bolt deflected: a bright rising ping.

assets.name: Blade_PerfectDeflect
assets.note: Perfect deflect, a signature: a full bell (A6 with fifth and octave) over a thump.

assets.name: Crew_Hit
assets.note: A crew trooper's armour taking a hit: a short thwack (plays with the blade's own hit, so it is quiet).

assets.name: Crew_ShieldHit
assets.note: A shot on an energy shield: glassy, rising, no thud.

assets.name: Crew_Death
assets.note: A Null trooper going down: its suit powers down, then a thud. No voice.

assets.name: Crew_Melee
assets.note: A crew melee / slam landing: a whoosh into a ground thud.

assets.name: Crew_RifleShot
assets.note: Trooper blaster rifle. NOT wired: the crew's bolt has no weapon FX asset to carry a Muzzle sound.

assets.name: Drone_Hum
assets.note: Crew drone rotor hum. NOT wired: crew characters have no loop slot.

assets.name: Foot_Step_Soil
assets.note: Footstep on Verdance: a soft thud with leaf crunch. NOT wired: no footstep slot exists.

assets.name: Foot_Step_Rock
assets.note: Footstep on Cinder: a harder click with grit. NOT wired.

assets.name: Foot_Dash
assets.note: NOT wired.

assets.name: Foot_Jump
assets.note: NOT wired.

assets.name: Foot_Land
assets.note: NOT wired.

assets.name: Player_Hurt
assets.note: The player hit on foot: a body thud and a faint ring. No voice. NOT wired.

assets.name: Ambience_Space
assets.note: Space room tone: a very low bed, a slow drone, a distant shimmer. NOT wired: no ambience slot exists.

assets.name: Ambience_Verdance
assets.note: Verdance, bioluminescent jungle: air through leaves, an insect shimmer that comes and goes, a soft glow hum, scattered chirps and drips. NOT wired.

assets.name: Ambience_Cinder
assets.note: Cinder, volcanic: a deep rumble, hot wind, lava pops and crackle. NOT wired.

assets.name: Pickup_Collect_Hull
assets.note: Hull repair pickup taken: a warm low knock and two rising bell notes (E4, B4). One take: a tonal signal the player learns.

assets.name: Pickup_Collect_Shield
assets.note: Shield pickup taken: a glassy rising shimmer (C6, G6) over a soft whoosh.

assets.name: Pickup_Collect_Power
assets.note: Power charge pickup taken: a fast charging sweep and three rising notes (A4, E5, A5).

assets.name: Pickup_Collect_Overcharge
assets.note: Overcharge pickup taken, the rare one: a sub hit, a rising major chord (A4, C#5, E5, A5) and a bright burst.

assets.name: Pickup_Drop
assets.note: A reward drops out of a wreck or a special asteroid: a short falling sparkle and a tick. No data slot yet (a pickup has Loop and Collect only): for T2's spawn.

assets.name: Travel_DescentRoar
assets.note: ENG-38 planet descent: the roar that carries across the planet load under the white cover. 2D mono loop: a low rumble, buffeting wind and a thin hiss of plasma. Deeper and heavier than Travel_AtmosphericEntry, which stood in for it.

assets.name: Story_ThreePulse
assets.note: The three-pulse signal (storyline: the pattern the pilot half-recognises): three even low pulses, 0.45 s apart, the third held longer. Played at the door that recognises the pilot (ATDDoor.AccessSound, set in code: no data slot) and wherever else the pattern sounds. One take: it is a signature.

assets.name: Dominion_EscapeAlarm
assets.note: The escape (run and flight out of the Dominion): a rising two-voice klaxon every 1.2 s over a low unstable rumble. 2D loop, SFX class (stops with pause). No data slot yet: for T5 (interior escape run) and T4 (escape flight).

assets.name: Field_Break_Small
assets.note: ENG-48: a small piece of the space field breaks (1-10 m: pebble, panel, pod). A dry crack and a short gritty body.

assets.name: Field_Break_Medium
assets.note: ENG-48: a medium rock splits into smalls (10-40 m). Crack, a falling stony body, a low thud, rattling debris.

assets.name: Field_Break_Large
assets.note: ENG-48: a large rock or a wreck splits into mediums (40 m and up). A deep double crack, a long rumble and a tail of debris.

assets.name: Field_Break_Special
assets.note: ENG-48: a special (crystal-veined) asteroid breaks and drops its reward. The medium break with a ringing crystal chime on top, so the ear knows this one paid out.

assets.name: Ship_Impact_Thud
assets.note: ENG-48: the player's ship strikes something solid (rock, wreck, hull) and bounces: a dull hull thud, a click and a short metal ring. Beside Collision_Scrape (the glancing hit). No data slot yet: for T1 (UTDShipMovementComponent::HandleShipImpact).

assets.name: Ship_Impact_Heavy
assets.note: ENG-48: a hard, near head-on strike: a deeper longer thud, two ringing hull tones and a rattle. No data slot yet: for T1.
